settings.menu.description: The name of the settings menu, the navigation of the settings pages in groups (the screen at /settings, and the column beside a settings page on wide screens), for assistive technology.

settings.back.description: The button at the top of a settings page that goes back to the settings menu, where the menu does not stand beside the page. A page under an entry (one keyword filter) goes back to its entry instead, by the entry's name (settings.entry.*).

settings.group.general.description: A group heading of the settings menu, over the entries Profile, Display and posting, and Notifications.

settings.group.people.description: A group heading of the settings menu, over the entries Relationships (blocked and muted accounts, muted servers, followed hashtags) and Keyword filters.

settings.group.access.description: A group heading of the settings menu, over the entries Security, Apps, and Invites: how the reader signs in, and what and who else gets in.

settings.group.account.description: A group heading of the settings menu, over the entry Account and data.

settings.entry.profile.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page, where the reader edits their profile.

settings.entry.profile.hint.defaultMessage: 名前、自己紹介、画像、バッジ、フォロワーの承認、検索への表示
settings.entry.profile.hint.description: The line under Profile in the settings menu at /settings: what its page holds, so that the reader finds a setting without opening every entry. A list of nouns, without a full stop.

settings.entry.display.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page: the language, the time zone, how the app shows things, and what a new post starts with.

settings.entry.display.hint.defaultMessage: 言語、タイムゾーン、リンクのプレビュー、新しい投稿の初期値、タイムラインの言語
settings.entry.display.hint.description: The line under Display and posting in the settings menu at /settings: what its page holds. A list of nouns, without a full stop.

settings.entry.notifications.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page, where the reader chooses what notifies them and how.

settings.entry.notifications.hint.defaultMessage: 通知する内容、プッシュ通知、メール、通知音、知らない人からの通知
settings.entry.notifications.hint.description: The line under Notifications in the settings menu at /settings: what its page holds (the kinds of notification and the ways each arrives, and what happens to notifications from people the reader does not know). A list of nouns, without a full stop.

settings.entry.relationships.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page, which lists the accounts the reader blocked or muted, the servers they muted, and the hashtags they follow.

settings.entry.relationships.hint.defaultMessage: ブロックしたアカウント、ミュートしたアカウント、ミュートしたサーバー、フォロー中のハッシュタグ
settings.entry.relationships.hint.description: The line under Relationships in the settings menu at /settings: the lists its page holds. A list of nouns, without a full stop.

settings.entry.filters.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page, which lists the reader's keyword filters; also the button at the top of one filter's page that goes back to the list.

settings.entry.filters.hint.defaultMessage: 投稿を隠す言葉やフレーズ
settings.entry.filters.hint.description: The line under Keyword filters in the settings menu at /settings: what a keyword filter is (posts with its words are folded behind the filter's name, or left out). Without a full stop.

settings.entry.security.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page: how the reader signs in and where they are signed in; also the button at the top of a page under it (the password, two-factor authentication) that goes back to it.

settings.entry.security.hint.defaultMessage: パスワード、パスキー、二要素認証、連携したアカウント、ログイン中のブラウザ
settings.entry.security.hint.description: The line under Security in the settings menu at /settings: what its page holds. Linked accounts are the reader's accounts on other services that they sign in with. A list of nouns, without a full stop.

settings.entry.apps.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page: the apps of other makers that the reader let use their account, and the apps the reader registered as their developer.

settings.entry.apps.hint.defaultMessage: アカウントの利用を許可したアプリ、自分で登録したアプリ
settings.entry.apps.hint.description: The line under Apps in the settings menu at /settings: the two lists its page holds. A list of nouns, without a full stop.

settings.entry.invites.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page, where the reader makes invites (a code, and a link with the code) that let people create an account on this server.

settings.entry.invites.hint.defaultMessage: このサーバーに人を招待するコードとリンク
settings.entry.invites.hint.description: The line under Invites in the settings menu at /settings: what its page holds. Without a full stop.

settings.entry.account.description: An entry of the settings menu, and the title of its page: the reader's data, and what becomes of the account; also the button at the top of a page under it that goes back to it.

settings.entry.account.hint.defaultMessage: エクスポートとインポート、古い投稿の自動削除、アカウントの移転、モデレーションの処分と異議申し立て、無効化と削除
settings.entry.account.hint.description: The line under Account and data in the settings menu at /settings: what its page holds (export and import of the reader's data, deleting their old posts automatically, moving the account to another server, the moderators' actions on the account and the reader's appeals, deactivating or deleting the account). A list of nouns, without a full stop.

settings.entry.count.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {確認が必要な項目 # 件}}
settings.entry.count.description: What the count at the end of an entry of the settings menu means, for assistive technology, read after the entry's name: how many things on its page wait for the reader (a moderation action to read, an export ready to download). count is that number, 1 or more.

settings.sign_out.description: The last row of the settings menu, apart from its groups: it signs this browser out, after a confirmation (settings.sign_out.title).

settings.sign_out.title.defaultMessage: このブラウザからログアウトしますか？
settings.sign_out.title.description: The question of the confirmation before the app signs the reader out of the browser they are using.

settings.sign_out.text.defaultMessage: ほかのブラウザやアプリはログインしたままです。書きかけの投稿と、オフラインで読むために保存したホームタイムラインは、このブラウザから削除されます。保存した下書きは残ります。
settings.sign_out.text.description: What signing out does, under the confirmation's question: only this browser is signed out; what the app kept in this browser alone is removed (a post being written and not saved as a draft, the newest posts of the home timeline kept for reading offline); the drafts saved on the server (compose.drafts.save) stay.

settings.sign_out.confirm.description: The button of the confirmation that signs this browser out.

settings.sign_out.cancel.description: The refusal of the confirmation of signing out: the reader stays signed in.

settings.sign_out.failed.defaultMessage: ログアウトを完了できませんでした。このブラウザはログインしたままの可能性があります。もう一度試してください。
settings.sign_out.failed.description: In the confirmation of signing out, which stays open, when the sign-out got no answer from the server (the network, the server): the reader presses the confirmation's button again.

settings.not_found.defaultMessage: この設定のページはありません。アドレスを確かめてください。
settings.not_found.description: In place of a settings page at an address under /settings that names none (/settings/nothing), the only thing the screen says of it: the screen's heading and the document's title stay Settings (app.settings). The link to the settings menu follows it on the same line (settings.not_found.all), so the sentence does not name the menu.

settings.not_found.all.description: The link right after settings.not_found, on the same line, that opens the settings menu at /settings; the words of the link after a missing announcement (announcements.all).

settings.loading.defaultMessage: 設定を読み込んでいます…
settings.loading.description: In place of the sections of a settings page while what it shows is being read from the server.

settings.failed.defaultMessage: 設定を読み込めませんでした。
settings.failed.description: In place of the sections of a settings page when what it shows could not be read from the server (the network, the server); Try again follows it on the same line (settings.retry).

settings.retry.description: The button after settings.failed that reads the settings from the server again.

settings.unsaved.defaultMessage: 「{setting}」を保存できませんでした。設定を開いて、もう一度変更してください。
settings.unsaved.description: A toast at the bottom of the screen, when a change of a setting was not saved (the network, the server, or a value the server refused) and the reader had already left the settings page, so that the row of the setting cannot say it: the setting went back to what it was. setting is the setting's name as its row shows it (Show new posts as they arrive). Its button opens the page of that setting (settings.unsaved.open).

settings.unsaved.open.description: The button of the toast settings.unsaved: it opens the settings page that holds the setting which was not saved.

settings.unsaved.close.description: The name of the close button of the toast settings.unsaved, for assistive technology: it puts the toast away.

settings.display.section.region.description: The heading of the first section of the Display and posting page of the settings, over the display language and the time zone.

settings.display.section.display.description: The heading of the section of the Display and posting page of the settings about how the app shows things (the size of link previews).

settings.display.section.posts.description: The heading of the section of the Display and posting page of the settings about what the composer starts a new post with.

settings.display.section.posts.about.defaultMessage: 新しい投稿は、ここで選んだ見られる人・言語で書きはじめます。投稿ごとに変えられます。
settings.display.section.posts.about.description: The line under the heading New posts: the first two choices of the section (Who can see it, Post language) are only where a post starts; the composer changes them for one post. It leaves out the third, requiring a description of media. Who can reply, boost and quote has a section of its own (settings.display.section.interactions).

settings.display.section.interactions.defaultMessage: 返信・ブースト・引用できる人
settings.display.section.interactions.description: The heading of the section of the Display and posting page of the settings about who may reply to, boost and quote the account's new posts by default; the composer's words for it (compose.permissions). Its three choices are Who can reply, Who can boost and Who can quote (settings.display.reply, settings.display.boost, settings.display.quote).

settings.display.section.interactions.ab.defaultMessage: 新しい投稿は、ここで選んだ返信・ブースト・引用できる人で書きはじめます。投稿ごとに変えられます。
settings.display.section.interactions.ab.description: The line under the heading Who can reply, boost and quote on the Display and posting page of the settings: the three choices of the section are only where a post starts; the composer changes them for one post (compose.permissions).

settings.display.section.timelines.description: The heading of the section of the Display and posting page of the settings about what the timelines show.

settings.display.language.description: The label of the choice of the language the app is shown in, on the Display and posting page of the settings: first Same as the browser (settings.display.browser), then the languages the app has, each by its own name.

settings.display.language.about.defaultMessage: 届くメールやプッシュ通知にも使います。
settings.display.language.about.description: The line under Display language: the server writes the emails and push notifications it sends the reader in this language too.

settings.display.browser.description: The first option of the display language and of the time zone on the Display and posting page of the settings: the app follows the language, or the time zone, that the browser is set to, on each device.

settings.display.time_zone.description: The label of the choice of the time zone the app shows dates and times in, on the Display and posting page of the settings: first Same as the browser (settings.display.browser), then the time zones.

settings.display.time_zone.region.defaultMessage: {region, select, Africa {アフリカ} America {南北アメリカ} Antarctica {南極} Arctic {北極} Asia {アジア} Atlantic {大西洋} Australia {オーストラリア} Europe {ヨーロッパ} Indian {インド洋} Pacific {太平洋} other {その他}}
settings.display.time_zone.region.description: The name of a group of time zones in the choice of the time zone, on the Display and posting page of the settings: the part of the world its places are in. region is the first part of the zones' names in the time zone database (Asia of Asia/Tokyo); the three oceans are named as oceans (Atlantic Ocean, Indian Ocean, Pacific Ocean). The choice offers no zone of another part, so other shows nowhere today; the format needs the branch.

settings.display.time_zone.option.description: A time zone in the choice of the time zone, under the name of its part of the world (settings.display.time_zone.region). place is the zone's place as the time zone database names it, in English (Tokyo, Buenos Aires); offset is how far its clocks are from UTC now, as the reader's language writes it (GMT+9).

settings.display.link_cards.defaultMessage: 投稿のリンクのプレビュー
settings.display.link_cards.description: The label of the choice of how large the card of a link in a post is (the page's picture, title and description), on the Display and posting page of the settings: Large or Small.

settings.display.link_cards.large.description: An option of Link previews in posts: the card has the page's picture above its text.

settings.display.link_cards.small.description: An option of Link previews in posts: the card has a small square picture beside its text.

settings.display.audience.description: The label of the choice of the visibility a new post starts with, in the New posts section of the Display and posting page of the settings; the composer's words for it (compose.audience). Its options are the composer's visibilities (compose.visibility.*).

settings.display.reply.description: The label of the choice of who may reply to a new post unless the reader changes it in the post, in the section Who can reply, boost and quote of the Display and posting page of the settings; the composer's words for it (compose.interaction.reply). Its options are the composer's audiences, each alone or with others by the author's approval, as the composer writes a choice (compose.permission.now).

settings.display.boost.description: The label of the choice of who may boost a new post unless the reader changes it in the post, in the section Who can reply, boost and quote of the Display and posting page of the settings; the composer's words for it (compose.interaction.announce). Its options are the composer's audiences, each alone or with others by the author's approval, as the composer writes a choice (compose.permission.now).

settings.display.quote.description: The label of the choice of who may quote a new post unless the reader changes it in the post, in the section Who can reply, boost and quote of the Display and posting page of the settings; the composer's words for it (compose.interaction.quote). Its options are the composer's audiences, each alone or with others by the author's approval, as the composer writes a choice (compose.permission.now).

settings.display.post_language.description: The label of the choice of the language a new post is marked as written in unless the reader changes it in the post, in the New posts section of the Display and posting page of the settings: first Same as the display language (settings.display.post_language.display), then languages, each by its own name.

settings.display.post_language.display.description: The first option of Post language: a new post starts in the language the app is shown in (settings.display.language).

settings.display.media_description.defaultMessage: メディアの説明を必須にする
settings.display.media_description.description: The label of a switch in the New posts section of the Display and posting page of the settings: on, the composer does not post an image, a video or audio that has no description (alt text) until the reader adds one. Short, to stay on one line on a phone; the line under it says the rest (settings.display.media_description.about).

settings.display.media_description.about.defaultMessage: オンにすると、説明 (代替テキスト) のないメディアは投稿できません。
settings.display.media_description.about.description: The line under Require media descriptions: what the switch does when on. Media is an image, a video or audio attached to a post; the description is the composer's (compose.description). While the server itself requires descriptions, settings.display.media_description.server stands in its place.

settings.display.media_description.serve.defaultMessage: このサーバーでは、すべてのメディアに説明が必要なため、常にオンです。
settings.display.media_description.serve.description: The line under Require media descriptions, in place of settings.display.media_description.about, while the server requires a description of every media file (the instance's limit require_media_description): the switch shows on and cannot be changed, and this says why.

settings.display.timeline_languages.description: The label of the choice of the languages whose posts the timelines show (several may be chosen), in the Timelines section of the Display and posting page of the settings.

settings.display.timeline_languages.abou.defaultMessage: 言語を選ぶと、ほかの言語の投稿は、どのタイムラインにも表示しません。言語が設定されていない投稿は表示します。
settings.display.timeline_languages.abou.description: The line under Languages to show, the same while no language is chosen (the choice says All languages, and nothing is left out) and once some are: with languages chosen, the home, list, local, federated and hashtag timelines leave out the posts marked as written in another language, and keep the posts marked with none.

settings.display.timeline_languages.all.description: What the choice of Languages to show says while no language is chosen: the timelines show posts in every language.

settings.display.timeline_languages.add.description: What the choice of Languages to show says once a language is chosen, in place of All languages (settings.display.timeline_languages.all): choosing a language there adds it to the list under it.

settings.display.timeline_languages.remo.description: The button at the end of a language in the list under Languages to show: it takes the language out of the list, and the timelines stop showing posts in that language alone; once the list is empty they show every language again. The word of the other buttons that take one thing out of a set (compose.remove, timeline.list_remove).

The name of the Remove button of a language in the list under Languages to show, for assistive technology; it holds the button's visible word (settings.display.timeline_languages.remove). language is the language's own name (日本語).

settings.display.auto_insert.defaultMessage: 新しい投稿が届いたらすぐに表示する
settings.display.auto_insert.description: The label of a switch in the Timelines section of the Display and posting page of the settings: on, a new post goes into the home timeline and the list timelines by itself; off, new posts wait until the reader presses the button over the timeline that counts them (timeline.new_posts).

settings.display.auto_insert.about.defaultMessage: オフにすると、タイムラインの上の「新しい投稿」のボタンを押すまで表示しません。
settings.display.auto_insert.about.description: The line under Show new posts as they arrive: what happens when the switch is off. The quoted words are those of the button over a timeline (timeline.new_posts: 3 new posts).

settings.profile.section.you.defaultMessage: あなたのプロフィール
settings.profile.section.you.description: A section heading of the Profile page of the settings, over the reader's own avatar, name and handle as others see them with the button Edit profile, the hashtags they feature, and the switch that marks the account as a bot.

settings.profile.section.badges.description: A section heading of the Profile page of the settings, over one switch for each badge the reader may show on their profile. The section is absent for a reader with no badge.

settings.profile.section.badges.about.defaultMessage: このサーバーから付与されたバッジです。オンにしたバッジは、プロフィールのハンドルの横に表示されます。
settings.profile.section.badges.about.description: The line under the Badges heading of the Profile page of the settings. A badge is a short name the server's administrators attach to some accounts (Moderator, Supporter); each is hidden until its owner shows it.

settings.profile.section.follows.defaultMessage: フォローとフォロワー
settings.profile.section.follows.description: A section heading of the Profile page of the settings, over the switch that makes follows need the reader's approval and the choice of who sees the lists of whom they follow and who follows them.

settings.profile.section.discovery.defaultMessage: アカウントの見つかり方
settings.profile.section.discovery.description: A section heading of the Profile page of the settings, over the switches that decide where the account and its public posts appear: suggestions and the search by name, search engines and this server's search of posts, AI, and the Atom feed.

settings.profile.edit.description: The button that opens the form where the reader changes their profile (pictures, display name, bio, fields): beside the reader's name on the Profile page of the settings, and at the top of the reader's own profile. Also the title of that form's page.

settings.profile.hashtags.description: The label of the field of the hashtags the reader features on their profile, on the Profile page of the settings; the profile's own words for them (profile.featured). A hashtag typed there is added at once.

settings.profile.hashtags.about.defaultMessage: {max, number} 個まで選べます。プロフィールに表示されます。
settings.profile.hashtags.about.description: The line under Featured hashtags on the Profile page of the settings. max is the most hashtags an account may feature (10).

settings.profile.hashtags.placeholder.description: The placeholder of the field of featured hashtags while it takes another one; the same words as the hashtags of an article (compose.article.tags.placeholder).

settings.profile.hashtags.full.defaultMessage: これ以上は追加できません
settings.profile.hashtags.full.description: The placeholder of the field of featured hashtags once it holds the most an account may feature, so that it takes no more.

settings.profile.hashtags.remove.description: The name of the button on a featured hashtag that removes it from the reader's profile, for assistive technology. tag is the hashtag without its #.

settings.profile.bot.defaultMessage: ボットのアカウントとして表示する
settings.profile.bot.description: The label of a switch on the Profile page of the settings: on, the account says it is automated, and the profile shows the mark Bot (profile.bot) beside its name.

settings.profile.bot.about.defaultMessage: プログラムが投稿するアカウント向けです。名前の横に「ボット」と表示されます。
settings.profile.bot.about.description: The line under Mark this account as a bot. The quoted word is the mark on the profile (profile.bot).

settings.profile.badge.description: The label of the switch that shows one badge on the reader's profile, or hides it. label is the name on the badge, written by the server's administrators (Moderator).

settings.profile.locked.defaultMessage: フォローを承認制にする
settings.profile.locked.description: The label of a switch on the Profile page of the settings: on, someone who wants to follow the reader sends a request, which the reader approves or declines; the profile then says Follow requests need approval (profile.locked).

settings.profile.locked.about.defaultMessage: フォローはリクエストとして届き、それぞれ承認するか断ります。オフにしても、すでに届いているリクエストは承認されません。
settings.profile.locked.about.description: The line under Require approval to follow you: what the switch does, and that the requests waiting when it is turned off stay until the reader answers them.

settings.profile.follows_visibility.defaultMessage: フォローとフォロワーの一覧を見られる人
settings.profile.follows_visibility.description: The label of the choice of who may open the lists of the accounts the reader follows and of their followers, on the Profile page of the settings. Its options are settings.profile.follows_visibility.option.

settings.profile.follows_visibility.abou.defaultMessage: 人数は誰でも見られます。
settings.profile.follows_visibility.abou.description: The line under Who can see your following and followers lists: how many accounts the reader follows and how many follow them shows on the profile whatever is chosen.

settings.profile.follows_visibility.opti.defaultMessage: {who, select, public {誰でも} followers {フォロワー} other {自分だけ}}
settings.profile.follows_visibility.opti.description: An option of Who can see your following and followers lists; the composer's words for the same audiences (compose.audience.everyone, compose.audience.followers, compose.audience.nobody). who is public, followers or private.

settings.profile.discoverable.defaultMessage: おすすめと名前の検索に表示する
settings.profile.discoverable.description: The label of a switch on the Profile page of the settings: on, the account is suggested to other people and the search of accounts finds it by a part of its name.

settings.profile.discoverable.about.defaultMessage: オフにすると、ユーザー名が完全に一致したときだけ検索で見つかります。
settings.profile.discoverable.about.description: The line under Appear in suggestions and in search by name: what happens when the switch is off.

settings.profile.indexable.defaultMessage: プロフィールと公開投稿を検索に載せる
settings.profile.indexable.description: The label of a switch on the Profile page of the settings: on, search engines and this server's search of posts may show the reader's profile and public posts.

settings.profile.indexable.about.defaultMessage: {where, select, both {検索エンジンと、このサーバーの投稿の検索に表示されます。} engines {検索エンジンに表示されます。} other {このサーバーは、すべてのアカウントで検索エンジンへの掲載を断っています。この選択は、このサーバーの投稿の検索にだけ反映されます。}}
settings.profile.indexable.about.description: The line under Include your profile and public posts in search: where the choice applies. where is both on a server that lets search engines in and has a search of posts, engines on one that lets search engines in and has no search of posts, and server on one that keeps search engines out and has a search of posts, where the choice applies to that search alone.

settings.profile.indexable.overridden.defaultMessage: このサーバーは、すべてのアカウントで検索エンジンへの掲載を断っているため、この選択は反映されません。
settings.profile.indexable.overridden.description: The line under Include your profile and public posts in search while the switch is disabled and shows off: the server's administrators keep search engines out, and the server has no search of posts, so the reader's profile and posts are in no search whatever they chose.

settings.profile.ai_opt_out.defaultMessage: AI の学習と利用を拒否する
settings.profile.ai_opt_out.description: The label of a switch on the Profile page of the settings: on, the reader's pages on this server state that AI may neither train on them nor use them (in AI search, assistants and agents).

settings.profile.ai_opt_out.about.defaultMessage: {server, select, deny_training {このサーバーは、すべてのアカウントで AI の学習を拒否しています。オンにすると、このサーバーのあなたのページは、AI の検索やアシスタントでの利用も拒否します。ほかのサーバーとメディアのファイルには反映されません。} other {オンにすると、このサーバーのあなたのページが、AI のクローラーに学習と利用の拒否を伝えます。ほかのサーバーとメディアのファイルには反映されません。}}
settings.profile.ai_opt_out.about.description: The line under Refuse AI training and use: what the switch does and where it stops (the copies of the reader's posts on other servers, and the media files, do not carry the statement). server is what the server itself states for every account: deny_training when it already refuses training and lets AI use the pages, anything else when it allows both.

settings.profile.ai_opt_out.overridden.defaultMessage: このサーバーは、すべてのアカウントで AI の学習と利用を拒否しているため、この選択は反映されません。
settings.profile.ai_opt_out.overridden.description: The line under Refuse AI training and use while the switch is disabled and shows on: the server's administrators refuse both for every account, so both are refused whatever the reader chose.

settings.profile.feed.defaultMessage: 公開投稿の Atom フィードを出す
settings.profile.feed.description: The label of a switch on the Profile page of the settings: on, the reader's public posts can be read in a feed reader, from an Atom feed at the profile's address. Atom is the name of the feed format.

settings.profile.feed.about.defaultMessage: {follows, select, yes {アカウントのない人も、フィードリーダーで公開投稿を読めます。ここで選ぶまでは、上の検索の設定に合わせて切り替わります。} overridden {アカウントのない人も、フィードリーダーで公開投稿を読めます。ここで選ぶまでは、検索についてのあなた自身の選択に合わせます。上のサーバーの決まりは、この選択を変えません。} other {アカウントのない人も、フィードリーダーで公開投稿を読めます。}}
settings.profile.feed.about.description: The line under Offer an Atom feed of your public posts. follows is yes while the reader has never set this switch: it then turns on and off with the switch above it, Include your profile and public posts in search; overridden while they have never set it and the switch above is disabled because the server keeps search engines out for every account: that switch then shows off, what the server enforces, while the feed still follows what the reader had chosen there; anything else once the reader set this switch, which then keeps their choice.

settings.profile.edit.section.pictures.description: A section heading of the Edit profile page of the settings, over the header image and the avatar.

settings.profile.edit.section.text.description: A section heading of the Edit profile page of the settings, over the display name and the bio.

settings.profile.header.description: The label of the picture across the top of the reader's profile, on the Edit profile page of the settings.

settings.profile.avatar.description: The label of the reader's avatar, the round picture beside their name, on the Edit profile page of the settings.

settings.profile.picture.choose.description: The button of the header image and of the avatar that opens the device's file picker, while there is no picture.

settings.profile.picture.replace.description: The button of the header image and of the avatar that opens the device's file picker to choose another picture in place of the one shown.

settings.profile.picture.remove.description: The button of the header image and of the avatar that removes the picture shown; the profile then shows none once the form is saved.

settings.profile.picture.failed.defaultMessage: {reason, select, processing {サーバーがこの画像を処理できませんでした。別の画像を選んでください。} other {この画像をアップロードできませんでした。もう一度保存するか、別の画像を選んでください。}}
settings.profile.picture.failed.description: Under the avatar or the header image on the Edit profile page when saving failed because of that picture and the server gave no words of its own. reason is processing when the server took the file and then could not turn it into a picture it can show, anything else when the upload did not get through.

settings.profile.name.description: The label of the field of the name the reader's account shows, on the Edit profile page of the settings.

settings.profile.name.over.defaultMessage: 表示名は {max, number} 文字以内にしてください。
settings.profile.name.over.description: Under the display name when it is longer than the limit.

settings.profile.note.description: The label of the field of the text about the reader that their profile shows under their name, on the Edit profile page of the settings.

settings.profile.note.over.defaultMessage: 自己紹介は {max, number} 文字以内にしてください。
settings.profile.note.over.description: Under the bio when it is longer than the limit.

settings.profile.count.left.description: What the count beside the display name or the bio says to a screen reader near the field's limit: how many characters are left.

settings.profile.count.over.description: What the count beside the display name or the bio says to a screen reader past the field's limit: by how many characters it is over.

settings.profile.fields.description: A section heading of the Edit profile page of the settings, and the name of the list under it: the short pairs of a label and its content that a profile shows under the bio (Website: https://example.org).

settings.profile.fields.about.defaultMessage: ラベルと内容の組を {max, number} 個まで追加できます (Web サイト、呼び方など)。プロフィールに表示され、URL はリンクになります。
settings.profile.fields.about.description: The line under the Fields heading of the Edit profile page. max is the most fields a profile has (4).

settings.profile.fields.empty.defaultMessage: 補足情報はまだありません。追加すると、Web サイトや呼び方などをプロフィールに表示できます。
settings.profile.fields.empty.description: In the place of the list of fields on the Edit profile page while the profile has none, over the button Add a field.

settings.profile.fields.add.description: The button that adds an empty field (a label and its content) to the list on the Edit profile page.

settings.profile.fields.name.description: The name and placeholder of the first box of a field on the Edit profile page: the short name of the field (Website).

settings.profile.fields.value.description: The name and placeholder of the second box of a field on the Edit profile page: what the profile shows under the label (https://example.org).

settings.profile.fields.legend.description: The name of one field of the list on the Edit profile page, for assistive technology, so that its two boxes are told from those of the next field. n is its place in the list, from 1.

settings.profile.fields.remove.defaultMessage: 補足情報 {n, number} を削除
settings.profile.fields.remove.description: The name of the button that removes one field from the list on the Edit profile page, for assistive technology. n is the field's place in the list, from 1.

settings.profile.save.description: The button at the bottom of the Edit profile page that saves every change of the form at once.

settings.profile.save.failed.defaultMessage: プロフィールを保存できませんでした。もう一度試してください。
settings.profile.save.failed.description: Beside the Save button of the Edit profile page when saving failed and the server gave no reason (no connection).

settings.profile.save.picture_failed.defaultMessage: 画像を使えなかったため、プロフィールは保存されませんでした。画像の下の説明を確認してください。
settings.profile.save.picture_failed.description: Beside the Save button of the Edit profile page when the avatar or the header image the reader picked could not be uploaded or was refused; what is wrong stands under that picture (settings.profile.picture.failed, or the server's own words).

settings.profile.leave.title.defaultMessage: 保存せずに移動しますか？
settings.profile.leave.title.description: The question of the confirmation that opens when the reader leaves the Edit profile page with changes they have not saved.

settings.profile.leave.text.defaultMessage: 保存していない変更は失われ、元に戻せません。
settings.profile.leave.text.description: The text of the confirmation that asks whether to leave the Edit profile page without saving.

settings.profile.leave.confirm.description: The button of the confirmation that leaves the Edit profile page and drops the changes not saved.

settings.profile.leave.cancel.description: The button of the confirmation that stays on the Edit profile page, with the changes as the reader left them.
